subject: house development
comment: Jonathon, This is Boyd and Sandy Brady, we would like to express our concerns on the plans from the two city councilors, from someone who actually lives on center street. We will try and make this short. This is not the only development that is being proposed, there is the land West of Tom Halliday and East of Benjamin Allen, where approx 72 homes are also being proposed. There is Duncan Aviation that employs hundreds, we have a hard time backing out of our driveway, Boyd has to drive out forward in the morings due to the employees going to work. We spoke to Steve Gleason the Airport manager about the expansion of the airport, we asked how many commercial airlines they are planning on, he said as many as they can get. Right now when a jet lands the line of cars going up center street is steady and that's only one airline. What about the schools if there are smaller houses/apartments/townhouses, that means small families with young children, the elementary school is full, I don't see where land is to build another school. I am sure that Rick Smith can tell you how far the cars get backed up past his house turning onto center street when the high school gets out. Also the turn around on those small houses they will eventually get bought up from investors and turned into rentals, I have seen this happen with the Rivers in our neighborhood. Our son who was the president of his HOA said that one person from California had bought three condos that he is renting out, Boyd and I are also guilty of this since we were self employed we bought two townhouse in Springville and Spanish Fork for investments to help with our retirement, that will happen here also, the dynamic of the neighborhood will change drastically good people will move out. Thank you for taking the time to read this, if you have any questions for us or more of our concerns please ask, also please let us know that you received this email. Thank you Boyd and Sandy Brady
